apps.name: Ignited
apps.subtitle: Retro games, modern design.
apps.localizedDescription:
Ignited is a multi-system emulator that allows you to play your favorite retro games. Focused on features, customization, and quality of life enhancements, Ignited offers an incredibly smooth and convenient experience.

Supported Systems:
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Nintendo DS (DS)\n- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (GEN)
- Sega Master System (SMS)
- Sega Game Gear (GG)

Features:
- Full Controller Support - Use any modern bluetooth or MFi controller
- Customizable Controller Skins - Change the color, style, and layout of the standard skins
- Custom Controller Skins - Create or download new skins to enhance your gameplay
- Adjustable Fast Forward - Use hold, toggle, or cycle modes to change to game speed to faster or slower than normal
- Cheats - Adds cheat codes to modify your games
- Save states - Save and load states, automatic save states, and quick saves
- Rewind - Go back to a previous point in gameplay within 1-5 minutes on supported systems
- Ignited Sync - Backup your games and saves
- App Theming - Choose a theme color to use for the UI, skins, and more
- Toast Notifications - Get notified when saving, loading, and performing other actions
- Favorite Games - Mark games as favorites to make them easier to find and play
- Animated Artwork - Use GIFs as your game artwork
- Customizable Audio - Choose when game audio plays and how loud
- Game Screenshots - Save the game screen to Files or Photos with an optional countdown
- Quick Settings - Access actions and settings quickly during gameplay
- AirPlay Support - Play your games on an external display
- Background Blur - Beautiful and customizable background for skins featuring a blurring version of the game screen
- Vibration - Feel your buttons with customizable vibration feedback
- Button Sounds - Hear your buttons with customizable audio feedback
- Touch Overlay - See your buttons with customizable visual feedback

* Ignited is in no way affiliated with Nintendo or Sega. The name "Nintendo" and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd. The name "Sega" and all associated game consoles are registered trademarks of Sega Corporation. *

apps.name: Regram
apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for Instagram
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has original Instagram bundle ID. You need to delete original Instagram before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with free Apple IDs.

Regram is your all-in-one tweak for Instagram. Currently in beta and available only to Patreon subscribers.
Activate license by connecting your Patren account from inside Regram Settings.

Access Regram settings by long-pressing on Home tab bar button or from Instagram settings.

apps.name: Twitter
apps.subtitle: NeoFreeBird version 6.7.0
apps.localizedDescription: NeoFreeBird-BHTwitter, changed to look like the app before the rebrand.

versions.localizedDescription:
New Features
- Updated X to 12.26 (adds scheduled tweets, not my work though)
- Added ability to use Tenor GIFs instead of GIPHY
- Added option to always download the highest-quality MP4 file from media downloads
- Added option to stop X from losing focus when staying out of the app for a long time

Fixes
- Fixed Japanese and Russian localizations
- Fixed the theme color not showing on horizontal scroll bars
- Fixed the Twitter icon in the top-left corner not tinting on iPad

Version 6.6.1

Fixes
- Fixed voice message downloading (now requires 2 fingers with a long press)
- Fixed a crash that would happen when encountering any confirmation prompt

New Features
- Updated X to 12.21
- Added ability to remove retweets of tweets from users who’ve blocked you
- Doomscrolling can now be turned off with disabling video scroll

**Fixes**
- Fixed X branding in newer versions
- Added Turkish, Japanese, and Spanish localizations

Known Issues
- Downloading voice messages and bypassing screenshot detection are broken, will be fixed soon™.

New Features
- Added option to disable the new media carousel (switches back to old grid view)

Fixes
- Fixed the “Confirm Follow” feature
- Added more Japanese translations (thank you @so-5699)
- Changed tap to pause to use 2 fingers instead of one (this now allows you to dismiss the media view)
- The in-app browser is off by default in LiveContainer installs (thank you @PeekPerformer)
- Fixed a hang on first startup in LiveContainer installs (thank you @PeekPerformer)

Updated X to 12.15

New Features
- Added option to see where an account is located in a tweet. Can spillover into next line at times
- Added option to disable screenshot detection in XChat

Fixes
- Fixes the “Restore Video Timestamp” option to prevent crashing on newer versions (fixes #23)
- Added back the theme color to the horizontal scroll bar (fixes #27)
- Forced the “more” bar to always be present (this was only an iPad issue)
- Fixed the video timestamp not reflecting the custom font
- Moved “Copy Profile Info” to the profile overflow menu. This now means you can’t copy profile info from your own profile, but you can click “Edit profile” and get that, so not a massive loss
- Fixed bookmarked posts from verified accounts not followed not showing when the option to hide verified tweets was on

Version 6.4.0

New Features
- Added option to download voice messages (due to how XChat encrypts attachments, you need to play the message to have the option to download it)
- Added ability to upload in 1080p (and 4k, but this is technically unsupported)
- Added option to see poll results before voting
- Added option to tap to play/pause video (video controls can’t be hidden with this option on, Twitter limitation)

Fixes
- Fixes the black launch screen and now shows it as blue the whole way through. There is an option to toggle it back to black.

New Features
- Added option to directly copy user URL
- Added option to hide the “typing” indicator in Chat
- Added a toggle to show unrounded counts, as well as added the ability to show the unrounded number of tweets
- The News tab is now hidden
- Added an option to disable the gesture to dock videos

Fixes
- Fixed tab labels being off-center
- Fixed the “Restore Video Timestamp” option
- Tinted some buttons in the Chat menu 
- Fixed the news button not being rebranded

Tweak version 6.2.1
- Fixed the tweet source label not being colored
- (Hopefully) fixed French rebranding text

Version 6.2.0
- Added an option to hide Blue checkmark tweets
- Added an option to hide the “Create Tweet” button
- Fixed Twitter rebranding in French

Version 6.1.3
Added a contributors section to the NeoFreeBird settings menu.

apps.name: Watusi
apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for WhatsApp Messenger
apps.localizedDescription:
Watusi is your all-in-one tweak for WhatsApp Messenger.

This is an original version, it has original WhatsApp bundle ID, you need to delete original WhatsApp before installing.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This lets you connect to supported Bluetooth devices
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This lets you connect to supported Bluetooth devices
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: This lets you create events on your calendar.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This lets you make video calls, take photos, and record videos.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Upload your contacts to WhatsApp's servers to help you quickly get in touch with your friends and help us provide a better experience.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to authenticate on WhatsApp.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you always allow access to your location, you can choose to share your live location, and it will update even when you're not using the app. If you only allow access while using the app, you can only send your current location or a nearby place.

privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti: This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you make calls, send voice messages, and record videos with sound.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This lets you save photos and videos to your library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This lets you send photos and videos from your library and save the ones you capture.
privacy.NSRemindersUsageDescription: This lets you set reminders to call your friends back.
privacy.NSSiriUsageDescription: This lets you use Siri to quickly send and read messages and make calls.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: WhatsApp does on-device recognition for Voice Messages. In this mode, no voice data is sent to Apple despite this alert, which is unexpected. Select "Don't Allow" and report to WhatsApp.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This will let you use WhatsApp to place and receive calls through devices that are on the same Wi-Fi or local access networks.
